summary.text: Danielle Ford is a first-term member of Nevada's State Board of Education and a former Clark County School District trustee, running for governor as a nonpartisan. She says she wants to be 'the education governor' and decided to run as an independent because she does not think the two-party system in Nevada is successful at the moment.

paragraphs.text: Former Clark County School District trustee and current member of the Nevada State Board of Education.

sources.title: Danielle Ford wants to be 'the education governor'
